svg.title: Recorded Cast v2 session
svg.desc: 46 frames from a recorded Cast v2 session between electron-cast and a Chromecast Ultra: device authentication, CONNECT, GET_STATUS, LAUNCH of the Default Media Receiver, RECEIVER_STATUS, media LOAD and MEDIA_STATUS, PING and PONG, PAUSE and PLAY, then STOP and CLOSE. Each frame appears in turn as a log row, silences over 1.5 seconds are marked and shortened, and ON AIR lights from LOAD to STOP. With reduced motion the first 16 frames show as a still.
svg.text: Recorded from a real session: electron-cast 0.4.0 casting to a Chromecast Ultra. Big Buck Bunny © Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0.
